#+title: Eta notes
#+FILETAGS: :notes:
* Notes
A real work doc that carries NO =#+state:= keyword.  airctl classifies a
stateless doc as =DocumentState::Unknown= (=state.unwrap_or(Unknown)=),
NOT =draft= — so it must never inflate the Draft count.  org-air mirrors
that (R20-5 fix): this doc classifies as UNKNOWN and renders with the
faded [U] badge, last in state order.
